hook: Your camel ride here is on a two-humped camel.
title: Sand Dunes in Front of Snow Peaks in India
description:
Hunder in Ladakh's Nubra Valley has sand dunes sitting at over 3,000 metres, with snow peaks behind them. You can ride double-humped Bactrian camels here. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Ladakh #IndiaFacts
